name: trace
description: Trace Python program execution in VS Code. Step through runtime state, inspect variables, visualize data structures, and investigate errors.

scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:trace-state && npm run test:history && npm run test:output && npm run test:structures && npm run test:visualization && npm run test:structure-style && npm run test:retention && npm run test:process-tree && npm run test:python-interpreter && npm run test:process-state && npm run test:input-detection

trace.pythonPath.description: Optional user-level Python executable override. When empty, Trace uses the interpreter selected in the Microsoft Python extension, then falls back to python3 on macOS/Linux or python on Windows.

trace.executionTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds allowed for a traced Python run. The process is terminated when this limit is reached.

trace.maxEvents.description: Maximum number of trace events recorded for one run. When the limit is reached, Trace stops the program and keeps the history recorded so far, so output after that point is not produced.

enumDescriptions: Ask for standard input only when the file appears to read it (input(), sys.stdin, fileinput).
Always ask for standard input before a run.
Never ask; the program receives empty standard input.
trace.promptForInput.description: Controls when Trace asks for standard input before running a file. "Run with Test Case" always asks.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Trace can open in Restricted Mode, but executing Python files requires a trusted workspace.
